requirements.text: Passion for building, love for growth, people and getting things done
At least 1 year of work experience, e.g. in business development, consulting, startups or operations
Strong social skills, able to win people over
Structured and organised, runs many things in parallel without dropping any
Fast learner, hard-working, stress-resistant, solves whatever problem comes up
Exceptional achievements during and beyond academic studies
Experience building teams or processes from scratch
Able to work full-time on-site in San Francisco or Berlin

resumes.text:
Lena Hartmann
Berlin, Germany

Summary
Operations and growth professional with four years across startups and logistics. I love growth work, I like getting things done, and I enjoy working closely with people who are building something new.

Experience
Operations Associate, Brightwater Logistics, Berlin (March 2023 to present)
- Won over 40 mid-market accounts in twelve months by running discovery calls that turned skeptical buyers into signed clients.
- Ran six workstreams at once, including a pricing pilot, two hiring pushes and a CRM migration, using a weekly tracker that nobody on the team ever missed.
- Known across the company as a fast learner who stays calm under pressure and works late when a launch demands it.
- Joined a 25-person sales team and maintained its established onboarding checklist and weekly reporting dashboard.

Business Development Representative, Feldmark Software GmbH, Hamburg (June 2021 to February 2023)
- Booked qualified meetings for the enterprise team and handed them over with clean notes.
- Trained two new hires on the outreach playbook within their first month.

Education
B.A. Economics, Northfield University, Hamburg (2018 to 2021)
Exceptional achievements: national finalist in a German university case competition and recipient of a merit scholarship awarded to the top one percent of students.

Skills
German (native), English (fluent, business level), Salesforce, HubSpot, SQL basics, Google Sheets automation.

Availability
Available for full-time on-site work in Berlin.

Tobias Keller
Munich, Germany

Summary
Recent economics graduate with one and a half years in business operations at an early-stage startup. I love growth work and I want to be where a company is taking shape.

Experience
Operations Analyst, Lumen Analytics GmbH, Munich (September 2024 to present)
- Picked up a new CRM and reporting stack within a week and documented the full workflow so the team could run it without me.
- Supports the finance and sales operations team with monthly close reports, vendor invoices and data cleanup.
- Prefers to focus on one project at a time, going deep on it before moving to the next task.

Intern, Stadtwerk Consulting Partners, Munich (April 2023 to August 2023)
- Assisted senior consultants with market research decks and benchmarking spreadsheets for energy clients.

Education
B.Sc. Business Administration, University of Augsburg (2020 to 2024)
Finished top of a 400-student cohort in the university's entrepreneurship program and won its pitch prize with a logistics app prototype.

Skills
German (native), English (fluent), Excel, Power BI basics, Notion, Python for light data work.

Availability
Currently working remotely from Hamburg, where I prefer to work from home. Open to discussing future locations.

Marta Silva
Lisbon, Portugal

Summary
Registered nurse with six years of ward experience. I love helping people and I am driven to see patients recover and go home.

Experience
Registered Nurse, Hospital de Santa Clara, Lisbon (2020 to present)
- Delivers medication rounds, wound care and discharge teaching on a general medical ward.
- Coordinates handovers between day and night shifts and documents patient care in the electronic health record.
- Member of the infection prevention committee, which updated hand hygiene audits in 2023.

Staff Nurse, Clinica Viva, Porto (2018 to 2020)
- Assisted with outpatient procedures and patient intake for a private clinic.

Education
Bachelor of Nursing Science, Instituto Superior de Saude, Lisbon (2014 to 2018)

Certifications
Basic Life Support, Medication Safety Certificate (renewed 2025).

Languages
Portuguese (native), German (fluent), English (fluent).

Availability
Works rotating shifts at the hospital in Lisbon and is not able to relocate at this time.
